shortDescription: 🔴 आज अंतिम तिथि – JNU Non Teaching 2026 (267 posts). Apply till 27 July 2026, 5:00 PM at jnunt.samarth.edu.in. Last date today!
content:
🔴 आज है आवेदन की अंतिम तिथि – 27 July 2026 (5:00 PM)

Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU), New Delhi has released Advertisement 01/RC(NT)/2026 for various Non-Teaching Group A, B and C posts.

Total vacancies: 267 (MTS, Stenographer, Junior Assistant and more). Online applications opened from 29 June 2026. Last date to apply is today – 27 July 2026 till 5:00 PM.

Apply only on the official portal jnunt.samarth.edu.in. No offline or email applications are accepted. Form बंद होने से पहले Submit कर लें।
